title: Rethinking Creativity Evaluation: A Critical Analysis of Existing Creativity Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of LLM-as-a-judge predictions using accuracy, F1 score, precision, recall, and confusion matrices to detect disproportionate classification towards a single label (e.g., disproportionately rating problem-solving solutions as 'Unconventional' or creative writing plots as 'non-original').
